privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: remember.me lets you build a gift that someone opens from a QR code. This page explains what we store to make that work.
privacy.s1Text: The content you add to a gift: names, texts, photos, voice notes, the trivia question and the surprise. Photos are converted and stripped of their metadata (including location) before they are stored. We do not create accounts and we do not ask for your email.
privacy.s2Text: Payments are handled by Stripe. We never see your card details. Stripe gives us the result of the payment and the email you enter at checkout, which we use only for the receipt Stripe sends you.
privacy.s3Text: Anyone who has the gift's link or QR code. Gift pages are not listed anywhere and search engines are told not to index them. The private edit link is stored only in your browser: keep it safe, because it is the only way to edit or delete the gift.
privacy.s4Text: You can delete a gift at any time from the editor. Its texts, photos and voice notes are removed from our systems.
privacy.s5Text: We do not use advertising or analytics cookies. Your browser stores your language preference and the edit links of your gifts.
privacy.s6Text: For any question about your data, write to the address shown on the legal notice of this site.
